license_review: REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLIC RELEASE. The weights are ours (trained on our data), but the architecture comes from bonito (ONT Public License v1.0) and the config.toml from SeqTagger — now vendored in-tree at scripts/nbc/crf_config.toml, which widens the exposure from "a file on the cluster" to "a third-party file in the repo". Neither is needed to RUN this ONNX, which is the reason to export the encoder at all, but the CC-BY-4.0 claim above has not been signed off. Do not tag a release until it is.

training.label_source: EDX 3' adapter calls via parasail (add_adapter_tags.py), gated to CLEAN (edx_margin>5 & score_best>=66)
training.pipeline: raw pA window [adapter_end - 3000, adapter_end] (adapter_end from adapter_rna004@v1.1.0 via `escpod demux detect --method cnn`) -> standardise with CORPUS mean/stdev -> CTC-CRF encoder -> transition scores -> Viterbi -> 44-nt sequence -> min edit distance to the EMITTED references

io_contract: input `signal` [batch,1,3000] float32 batch-major, standardised raw pA; output `scores` [300,batch,1280] float32 TIME-major (T = chunk/stride 10; n_score = (n_base+1)*n_base**state_len = 5*4^4 = 1280). The CRF decode is NOT in the graph — standard ONNX ops cannot express it; the consumer runs a Viterbi over 256 states x 5 transitions.

metrics.split: the corpus's recorded held-out split, carved per code BEFORE the cap by extract_chunks.py, so these reads were never trained on
metrics.note: Per flowcell, never one 16x16: the pilot aliases nbc identity with flowcell (issue #26). Edit distances are against the reference the model EMITS (target[state_len:]); scoring against the full-length target inflates every distance and compresses the margin (issue #36).

notes: Retrained at the corrected geometry (issue #36). state_len=4 means the CRF emits target[4:]; the 48-nt target puts those four sacrificial bases in the oligo's constant prefix so the full 27-nt code is emitted, where the previous 40-nt target discarded the code's first four bases and discriminated on 23 nt. Measured accuracy-neutral at 16-plex across 4 geometries x 3 seeds — the 16-plex is not discrimination-limited — but it restores the separability the 96-code pool was designed for, which an 80-plex needs. Match decodes against the EMITTED references shipped in the bundle, never the full-length targets. The pilot is CONFOUNDED (each nbc on exactly one flowcell): report two 8x8 matrices, never one 16x16.
